_note: Module metadata for disease-site cards and landing pages. Everything here describes content that already exists in docs/ (topics, objectives) or is named in it (guideline, staging, trials). 'reviewed' is optional (e.g. "2026-10"); the UI only shows a review date when one is recorded here. 'modules' holds per-reading metadata (lede, essentials, objectives), each written from that reading's own sections and High-Yield Summary.
